items.title: Carnival posts record Q3 revenue as cruises navigate higher fuel costs
items.summary: Shares of cruise line operator Carnival Corporation (CCL) are jumping in Tuesday's pre-market trading after topping third quarter earnings estimates and posting $8.44 billion of revenue. The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley weigh in on Carnival's results and what it signals for the cruise industry.

items.title: CCL Q3 Deep Dive: Destination Strategy and Operational Discipline Drive Outperformance
items.summary: Cruise ship company Carnival (NYSE:CCL) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 3.5% year on year to $8.44 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.43 per share was 5.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Why Are Carnival (CCL) Shares Soaring Today
items.summary: Shares of cruise ship company Carnival (NYSE:CCL) jumped 11.6% in the afternoon session after it reported third-quarter 2026 results with record net income and raised its full-year adjusted net income forecast. According to the company’s press release, Carnival delivered record net income of $1.9 billion, adjusted net income of $2.0 billion, and record revenue and net yields in constant currency.
